q: Father is aged three times more than his son Ronit. After 8 years, he would be two and a half times of Ronit's age. After further 8 years, how many times would he be of Ronit's age?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Let}}\,{\text{Ronit's}}\,{\text{present}}\,{\text{age}}\,{\text{be}}\,x\,{\text{years}}. \\ & {\text{Then,}}\,{\text{father's}}\,{\text{present}}\,{\text{age}}\, \\ & = \left( {x + 3x} \right)\,{\text{years}} \\ & = 4x\,{\text{years}} \\ & \therefore \left( {4x + 8} \right) = \frac{5}{2}\left( {x + 8} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 8x + 16 = 5x + 40 \\ & \Rightarrow 3x = 24 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 8 \\ & {\text{Hence,}}\,{\text{required}}\,{\text{times}} \\ & = \frac{{ {4x + 16} }}{{ {x + 16} }} \\ & = \frac{{48}}{{24}} \\ & = 2 \end{aligned}$$

q: The sum of ages of 5 children born at the intervals of 3 years each is 50 years. What is the age of the youngest child?
s: Let the ages of children be x , ( x + 3), ( x + 6), ( x + 9) and ( x + 12) years. Then, x + ( x + 3) + ( x + 6) + ( x + 9) + ( x + 12) = 50 ⇒ 5 x = 20 ⇒ x = 4. ∴ Age of the youngest child = x = 4 years.

q: A father said to his son, "I was as old as you are at the present at the time of your birth". If the father's age is 38 years now, the son's age five years back was:
s: Let the son's present age be x years. Then, (38 - x ) = x ⇒ 2 x = 38. ⇒ x = 19. ∴ Son's age 5 years back (19 - 5) = 14 years.

q: A is two years older than B who is twice as old as C. If the total of the ages of A, B and C be 27, the how old is B?
s: Let C's age be x years. Then, B's age = 2 x years. A's age = (2 x + 2) years. ∴ (2 x + 2) + 2 x + x = 27 ⇒ 5 x = 25 ⇒ x = 5. Hence, B's age = 2 x = 10 years.

q: Present ages of Sameer and Anand are in the ratio of 5 : 4 respectively. Three years hence, the ratio of their ages will become 11 : 9 respectively. What is Anand's present age in years?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Let}}\,{\text{the}}\,{\text{present}}\,{\text{ages}}\,{\text{of}}\,{\text{Sameer}}\,{\text{and}}\,{\text{Anand}}\,{\text{be}}\, \\ & 5x\,{\text{years}}\,{\text{and}}\,4x\,{\text{years}}\,{\text{respectively}} \\ & {\text{Then,}}\,\frac{{5x + 3}}{{4x + 3}} = \frac{{11}}{9} \\ & \Rightarrow 9\left( {5x + 3} \right) = 11\left( {4x + 3} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 45x + 27 = 44x + 33 \\ & \Rightarrow 45x - 44x = 33 - 27 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 6 \\ & \therefore {\text{Anand's}}\,{\text{present}}\,{\text{age}} \\ & = 4x \\ & = 24\,{\text{years}}\, \end{aligned}$$

q: A man is 24 years older than his son. In two years, his age will be twice the age of his son. The present age of his son is:
s: Let the son's present age be x years. Then, man's present age = ( x + 24) years. ∴ ( x + 24) + 2 = 2( x + 2) ⇒ x + 26 = 2 x + 4 ⇒ x = 22

q: Six years ago, the ratio of the ages of Kunal and Sagar was 6 : 5. Four years hence, the ratio of their ages will be 11 : 10. What is Sagar's age at present?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Let}}\,{\text{the}}\,{\text{ages}}\,{\text{of}}\,{\text{Kunal}}\,{\text{and}}\,{\text{S agar}}\,{\text{6}}\,{\text{years}}\,{\text{ago}}\, \\ & {\text{be}}\,6x\,{\text{and}}\,5x\,{\text{years}}\,{\text{respectively}} \\ & {\text{Then,}}\,\frac{{\left( {6x + 6} \right) + 4}}{{\left( {5x + 6} \right) + 4}} = \frac{{11}}{{10}} \\ & \Rightarrow 10\left( {6x + 10} \right) = 11\left( {5x + 10} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 5x = 10 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 2 \\ & \therefore {\text{Sagar's}}\,{\text{present}}\,{\text{age}} \\ & = \left( {5x + 6} \right)\,{\text{years}} \\ & = 16\,{\text{years}}\, \end{aligned}$$

q: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 60 years. Six years ago, father's age was five times the age of the son. After 6 years, son's age will be:
s: Let the present ages of son and father be x and (60 - x ) years respectively. Then, (60 - x ) - 6 = 5( x - 6) ⇒ 54 - x = 5 x - 30 ⇒ 6 x = 84 ⇒ x = 14 ∴ Son's age after 6 years = ( x + 6) = 20 years.

q: At present, the ratio between the ages of Arun and Deepak is 4 : 3. After 6 years, Arun's age will be 26 years. What is the age of Deepak at present ?
s: Let the present ages of Arun and Deepak be 4 x years and 3x years respectively. Then, 4x + 6 = 26 ⇒ 4x = 20 ⇒ x = 5 ∴ Deepak's age = 3x = 15 years.

q: Sachin is younger than Rahul by 7 years. If their ages are in the respective ratio of 7 : 9, how old is Sachin?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Let}}\,{\text{Rahul's}}\,{\text{age}}\,{\text{be}}\,x\,{\text{years}}. \\ & {\text{Then,}}\,{\text{Sachin's}}\,{\text{age}} = \left( {x - 7} \right)\,{\text{years}}. \\ & \therefore \frac{{x - 7}}{x} = \frac{7}{9} \\ & \Rightarrow 9x - 63 = 7x \\ & \Rightarrow 2x = 63 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 31.5 \\ & {\text{Hence,}}\,{\text{Sachin's}}\,{\text{age}} \\ & = \left( {x - 7} \right)\,{\text{years}} \\ & = 24.5\,{\text{years}} \end{aligned}$$

q: The present ages of three persons in proportions 4 : 7 : 9. Eight years ago, the sum of their ages was 56. Find their present ages (in years).
s: Let their present ages be 4 x , 7 x and 9 x years respectively. Then, (4 x - 8) + (7 x - 8) + (9 x - 8) = 56 ⇒ 20 x = 80 ⇒ x = 4 ∴ Their present ages are 4 x = 16 years, 7 x = 28 years and 9 x = 36 years respectively.

q: Ayesha's father was 38 years of age when she was born while her mother was 36 years old when her brother four years younger to her was born. What is the difference between the ages of her parents?
s: Mother's age when Ayesha's brother was born = 36 years. Father's age when Ayesha's brother was born = (38 + 4) years = 42 years. ∴ Required difference = (42 - 36) years = 6 years.

q: A person's present age is two-fifth of the age of his mother. After 8 years, he will be one-half of the age of his mother. How old is the mother at present?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Let}}\,{\text{the}}\,{\text{mother's}}\,{\text{present}}\,{\text{age}}\,{\text{be}}\,x\,{\text{years}}{\text{.}} \\ & {\text{Then,}}\,{\text{the}}\,{\text{person's}}\,{\text{present}}\,{\text{age}} \\ & = {\frac{2}{5}x} \,\,{\text{years}} \\ & \therefore {\frac{2}{5}x + 8} = \frac{1}{2}\left( {x + 8} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 2\left( {2x + 40} \right) = 5\left( {x + 8} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow x = 40 \end{aligned}$$

q: Q is as much younger than R as he is older than T. If the sum of the ages of R and T is 50 years, what is definitely the difference between R and Q's age?
s: Given that: 1. The difference of age b/w R and Q = The difference of age b/w Q and T. 2. Sum of age of R and T is 50 i.e. (R + T) = 50. Question: R - Q = ?. Explanation: R - Q = Q - T (R + T) = 2Q Now given that, (R + T) = 50 So, 50 = 2Q and therefore Q = 25. Question is (R - Q) = ? Here we know the value(age) of Q (25), but we don't know the age of R. Therefore, (R-Q) cannot be determined.

q: The age of father 10 years ago was thrice the age of his son. Ten years hence, father's age will be twice that of his son. The ratio of their present ages is:
s: Let the ages of father and son 10 years ago be 3x and x years respectively. Then, (3x + 10) + 10 = 2[(x + 10) + 10] ⇒ 3x + 20 = 2x + 40 ⇒ x = 20 ∴ Required ratio = (3x + 10) : (x + 10) = 70 : 30 = 7 : 3

q: The ages of Nitish and Vinnee are in the ratio 6 : 5 respectively. After 9 years the ratio of their ages will be 9 : 8. What is the difference in their ages now ?
s: Let Nishi's age be 6x years, Then Vinnee's age = 5x years $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore \frac{{6x + 9}}{{5x + 9}} = \frac{9}{8} \\ & \Rightarrow 8\left( {6x + 9} \right) = 9\left( {5x + 9} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 48x - 45x = 81 - 72 \\ & \Rightarrow 3x = 9 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 3 \\ & {\text{Difference in their ages}} \\ & {\text{ = }}\left( {6x - 5x} \right) \\ & = x {\text{ years}} \\ & = {\text{3 years}} \end{aligned}$$

q: The ages of Shakti and Kanti are in the ratio of 8 : 7 respectively. After 10 years, the ratio of their ages will be 13 : 12. What is the difference between their ages ?
s: Let Shakti's age be 8$$x$$ years, Then Kanti's age = 7$$x$$ years $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore \frac{{8x + 10}}{{7x + 10}} = \frac{{13}}{{12}} \\ & \Rightarrow 12\left( {8x + 10} \right) = 13\left( {7x + 10} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 96x + 120 = 91x + 130 \\ & \Rightarrow 5x = 10 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 2 \end{aligned}$$ Difference between their ages $$\begin{aligned} & = \left( {8x - 7x} \right) \\ & = {\text{ }}x\,{\text{years}} \\ & {\text{ = 2}}\,{\text{years}} \end{aligned}$$

q: The ages of A and B are in the ratio 6 : 5 and the sum of their ages is 44 years. What will be the ratio of their ages after 8 years ?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{A's age = }}\left( {44 \times \frac{6}{{11}}} \right){\text{years}} \\ & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,{\text{ = 24 years}} \\ & {\text{And B's age = }}\left( {44 - 24} \right){\text{years}} \\ & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,{\text{ = 20 years}} \end{aligned}$$ Ratio of their ages after 8 years $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{ = }}\frac{{\left( {24 + 8} \right)}}{{\left( {20 + 8} \right)}} \\ & = \frac{{32}}{{28}} \\ & = \frac{8}{7} \\ & = 8:7 \end{aligned}$$

q: Farah got married 8 years ago, Today her age is $$1\frac{2}{7}$$ times her age at the time of her marriage. At present her daughter's age is one-sixth of her age. What was her daughter's age 3 years ago ?
s: Let Farah's age 8 years ago be x years. Then , her present age = (x + 8) $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore x + 8 = \frac{9}{7}x \\ & \Rightarrow 7x + 56 = 9x \\ & \Rightarrow 2x = 56 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 28 \end{aligned}$$ ∴ Farah's age now = (x + 8) years = (28 + 8) years = 36 Her daughter's age now =$$\left( {\frac{1}{6} \times 36} \right)$$ years = 6 years Her daughter's age 3 years ago = (6 - 3) years = 3 years

q: The age of a mother today is thrice that of her daughter. After 12 years , the age of the mother will be twice that of her daughter. The present age of the daughter is = ?
s: Let the daughter's age be x years. Then, mother age = 3x years 3x + 12 = 2 (x + 12) ⇒ 3x + 12 = 2x + 24 ⇒ x = 12 Present age of daughter = 12 years

q: The present age of Mr. Sanyal is three times the age of his son. Six years hence , the ratio of their ages will be 5 : 2. What is the present age of Mr. Sanyal ?
s: Let the son's age be $$x$$ years , Then Mr. Sanyal's age = 3$$x$$ years $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore \frac{{3x + 6}}{{x + 6}} = \frac{5}{2} \\ & \Rightarrow 2\left( {3x + 6} \right) = 5\left( {x + 6} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 6x + 12 = 5x + 30 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 18 \end{aligned}$$ ∴ Present age of Mr. Sanyal = 3x years = (3 × 18) years = 54 years

q: The average of the ages of a man and his daughter is 34 years. If the respective ratio of their ages four years from now is 14 : 5,what is daughter's present age ?
s: Average age of man and his daughter = 34 years Their total age = (34 × 2) years = 68 years Let man's age be x years, Then daughter age = (68 - x) years $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore \frac{{x + 4}}{{68 - x + 4}} = \frac{{14}}{5} \\ & \Rightarrow 5\left( {x + 4} \right) = 14\left( {72 - x} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 5x + 20 = 1008 - 14x \\ & \Rightarrow 19x = 988 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 52 \end{aligned}$$ ∴ Daughter's present age = (68 - 52) years = 16 years Alternate Solution : According to question, After 4 years, the total age of man & daughter is = [(34 × 2) + 4 + 4] = 76 years After 4 years their age ratio is 14 : 5 (given) So, 4 years after the daughter age will be = 76 × $$\frac{5}{19}$$ = 20 years ∴ Daughter present age = 20 - 4 = 16 years

q: The age of a father 10 years ago was thrice the age of his son. 10 years hence , the father's age will be twice that of his son. The ratio of their present age is = ?
s: Let son's age 10 years ago be $$x$$ years Then, father age 10 years ago = 3$$x$$ years Son's age now = ($$x$$ + 10) years, Father age now = (3$$x$$ + 10) years $$\begin{aligned} & \left( {3x + 10} \right) + 10 = 2\left[ {\left( {x + 10} \right) + 10} \right] \\ & \Rightarrow 3x + 20 = 2\left( {x + 20} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 3x + 20 = 2x + 40 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 20 \end{aligned}$$ Ratio of present ages of father and son $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{ = }}\frac{{3x + 10}}{{x + 10}} \\ & = \frac{{3 \times 20 + 10}}{{20 + 10}} \\ & = \frac{{70}}{{30}} \\ & = \frac{7}{3} \\ & = 7:3 \end{aligned}$$

q: At present Suresh's age is twice the age of his daughter. After 6 year from now, the ratio of the ages of Suresh and his daughter will be 23 : 13. What is the present age of Suresh ?
s: Let daughter's age be x years. Suresh's age = 2x years $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore \frac{{2x + 6}}{{x + 6}} = \frac{{23}}{{13}} \\ & \Rightarrow 13\left( {2x + 6} \right) = 23\left( {x + 6} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 26x + 78 = 23x + 138 \\ & \Rightarrow 3x = 60 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 20 \end{aligned}$$ Present age of Suresh = 2x years $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{ = }}\left( {2 \times 20} \right){\text{ years }} \\ & {\text{ = 40 years}} \end{aligned}$$

q: Ten years ago, a man was seven times as old as his son. Two years hence, twice his age will be equal to five times the age of his son. What is the present age of the son ?
s: Let son's age 10 years ago be x years. Then, man's age 10 years ago = 7x years Son's present age = (x + 10) years, Man's present age = (7x + 10) years $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore {\text{2}}\left[ {\left( {7x + 10} \right) + 2} \right]{\text{ = 5}}\left[ {\left( {x + 10} \right) + 2} \right] \\ & \Rightarrow 2\left( {7x + 12} \right) = 5\left( {x + 12} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 14x + 24 = 5x + 60 \\ & \Rightarrow 9x = 36 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 4 \end{aligned}$$ Son's present age = (x + 10) years = (4 + 10) years = 14 years

q: The ages of Samina and Suhana are in the ratio of 7 : 3 respectively. After 6 years, the ratio of their ages will be 5 : 3. What is the difference in their ages?
s: Let Samina's age be 7x years. Then, Suhana's age = 3x years $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore \frac{{7x + 6}}{{3x + 6}} = \frac{5}{3} \\ & \Rightarrow 3\left( {7x + 6} \right) = 5\left( {3x + 6} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 21x + 18 = 15x + 30 \\ & \Rightarrow 6x + 12 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 2 \end{aligned}$$ Difference in their ages = (7x - 3x) years = 4x years = (4 × 2) years = 8 years

q: The ages of A and B are presently in the ratio of 5 : 6 respectively. Six years hence, this ratio became 6 : 7 respectively. What was B's age 5 years ago ?
s: Let A's age be 5x years. Then, B's age = 6x years $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore \frac{{5x + 6}}{{6x + 6}} = \frac{6}{7} \\ & \Rightarrow 7\left( {5x + 6} \right) = 6\left( {6x + 6} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 35x + 42 = 36x + 36 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 6 \end{aligned}$$ B's age 5 years ago = (6x - 5) years = (6 × 6 - 5) years = 31 years

q: The sum of the ages of a daughter and her mother is 56 years. After 4 years, the age of the mother will be three times that of the daughter. At present their ages are ?
s: Let daughter's age be $$x$$ years. Then, mother's age = (56 $$-\, x\,$$) years $$\begin{aligned} & \left( {56 - x} \right)+4 = 3\left( {x + 4} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 60 - x = 3x + 12 \\ & \Rightarrow 4x = 48 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 12 \end{aligned}$$ ∴ Daughter's age = 12 years And the mother's age = (56 $$-$$ 12) = 44 years

q: The present age of son is half of the present age of his mother. Ten years ago, his mother's age was thrice the age of her son. What is the present age of the son ?
s: Let mother's age be 2x years, Then, son's age = x years $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore \left( {2x - 10} \right) = 3\left( {x - 10} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 2x - 10 = 3x - 30 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 20 \end{aligned}$$ Son's age = 20 years

q: Ram's son's age is $$\frac{1}{3}$$ of Ram's wife's age. Ram's wife's age is $$\frac{4}{5}$$ of Ram's age and Ram's age is $$\frac{3}{5}$$ of Ram's father's age. Find the age of Ram's son, if Ram's father is 50 years old ?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Ram's father's age}} \\ & {\text{ = 50 years, }} \\ & {\text{Ram's age}} \\ & {\text{ = }}\left( {\frac{3}{5} \times 50} \right){\text{years}} \\ & {\text{ = 30 years}} \\ & {\text{Ram's wife's age}} \\ & {\text{ = }}\left( {\frac{4}{5} \times 30} \right){\text{years}} \\ & {\text{ = 24 years}} \\ & {\text{Ram's son's age}} \\ & {\text{ = }}\left( {\frac{1}{3} \times 24} \right){\text{years}} \\ & {\text{ = 8 years}} \end{aligned}$$

q: Rajan got married 8 years ago. His present age is $$\frac{6}{5}$$ times his age at the time of his marriage. Rajan's sister was 10 years younger to him at the time of his marrige. The age of Rajan's sister is = ?
s: Let Rajan's age 8 years ago be x years, Then, present age = (x + 8) years $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore x + 8 = \frac{6}{5}x \\ & \Rightarrow 5x + 40 = 6x \\ & \Rightarrow x = 40 \end{aligned}$$ Rajan's sister's age 8 years ago = (40 - 10) years = 30 years ∴ His sister's age now = (30+8) years = 38 years

q: A couple has a son and a daughter. The age of the father is four times that of the son and the age of the daughter is one-third of that of her mother. The wife is 6 years younger to her husband and the sister is 3 years older then her brother. The mother's age is = ?
s: M → Mother, F → Father, S → Son and D → Daughter F = 4S, D = $$\frac{1}{3}$$M, M = F - 6 and S = D - 3 $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore M = 3D = 3\left( {S + 3} \right) \\ & = 3S + 9 = \frac{3}{4}F + 9 = \frac{3}{4}\left( {M + 6} \right) + 9 \\ & = \frac{3}{4}M + \frac{3}{4} \times 6 + 9 \\ & \Rightarrow \left( {M - \frac{3}{4}M} \right) = \left( {\frac{9}{2} + 9} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{1}{4}M = \frac{{27}}{2} \\ & \Rightarrow M = \left( {\frac{{27}}{2} \times 4} \right) \\ & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, = 54\,{\text{years}} \\ & \therefore {\text{ The mother is 54 years old}}{\text{.}} \end{aligned}$$

q: Reenu's father was 38 years of age when she was born while her mother was 36 years old when her brother 4 years younger to her was born. What is the difference between the ages of her parents ?
s: Mother's age when Reenu's brother was born = 36 year Father's age when Reenu's brother was born = (38 + 4) years = 42 year Required difference = (42 - 36) years = 6 years

q: A man was asked to state his age in years. His reply was, "Take my age 3 years hence, multiply it by 3 and then subtract 3 times my age 3 years ago and you will know how old I am". What is the age of the man ?
s: Let the present age of the man be x years Then, $$\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow {\text{3}}\left( {x + 3} \right) - 3\left( {x - 3} \right) = x \\ & \Rightarrow \left( {3x + 9} \right) - \left( {3x - 9} \right) = x \\ & \Rightarrow x = 18 \end{aligned}$$ ∴ The present age of the man is 18 years

q: The ratio of a man's age and his son's age is 7 : 3 and the product of their ages is 756. The ratio of their ages after 6 years will be ?
s: Let the man's age be 7x years , Then son's age = 3x years $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore {\text{7}}x \times 3x = 756 \\ & \Rightarrow 21{x^2} = 756 \\ & \Rightarrow {x^2} = 756 \\ & \Rightarrow {x^2} = 36 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 6 \end{aligned}$$ The ratio of their ages after 6 years $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{ = }}\left( {7x + 6} \right):\left( {3x + 6} \right) \\ & = \left( {7 \times 6 + 6} \right):\left( {3 \times 6 + 6} \right) \\ & = 48:24 \\ & = 2:1 \end{aligned}$$

q: The ratio between the parents ages of A and B is 5 : 3 respectively. The ratio between A's age 4 years ago and B's 4 years hence is 1 : 1. What is the ratio between A's age 4 years hence and B's age 4 years ago ?
s: Let A's age be 5x years, then B's age = 3x years $$\begin{aligned} & \frac{{5x - 4}}{{3x + 4}} = \frac{1}{1} \\ & \Rightarrow 5x - 4 = 3x + 4 \\ & \Rightarrow 2x = 8 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 4 \\ & \therefore \frac{{{\text{A's age 4 years hence}}}}{{{\text{B's age 4 years ago }}}} \\ & = \frac{{5x + 4}}{{3x - 4}} \\ & = \frac{{5 \times 4 + 4}}{{3 \times 4 - 4}} \\ & = \frac{{24}}{8} \\ & = \frac{3}{1} \\ & = 3:1 \end{aligned}$$

q: The ratio between the ages of Neelam and Shiny is 5 : 6 respectively. If the ratio between the one-third age of Neelam and half of Shiny's age is 5 : 9, then what is Shiny's age = ?
s: Let Neelam's age be 5x years and Shiny's age be 6x years $$\begin{aligned} & \left( {\frac{1}{3} \times 5x} \right):\left( {\frac{1}{2} \times 6x} \right) = 5:9 \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{5x}}{{3 \times 3x}} = \frac{5}{9} \end{aligned}$$ Thus, Shiny's age cannot be determined

q: 18 years ago, a man was three times as old as his son. Now, the man is twice as old as his son. The sum of the present ages of the man and his son is = ?
s: Let the son's age 18 years ago be x years, Then man's age 18 years ago = 3x years $$\begin{aligned} & \left( {3x + 18} \right) = 2\left( {x + 18} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 3x + 18 = 2x + 36 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 18 \end{aligned}$$ Sum of their present ages $$\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow \left( {3x + 18 + x + 18} \right){\text{years}} \\ & \Rightarrow \left( {4x + 36} \right){\text{years}} \\ & \Rightarrow \left( {4 \times 18 + 36} \right){\text{years}} \\ & \Rightarrow {\text{ 108 years}} \end{aligned}$$

q: The age of a man 10 years ago was thrice the age of his son. 10 years hence, the man's age will be twice the age of his son. The ratio of their present ages is = ?
s: Let son's age 10 years ago be x years, Then man's age 10 years ago = 3x years Son's present age = (x + 10) years , Man's present age = (3x + 10) years $$\begin{aligned} & \left( {3x + 10} \right) + 10 = 2\left( {x + 10 + 10} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 3x + 20 = 2\left( {x + 20} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 3x + 20 = 2x + 40 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 20 \end{aligned}$$ Ratio of present ages of man and the son $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{ = }}\frac{{3x + 10}}{{x + 10}} \\ & = \frac{{3 \times 20 + 10}}{{20 + 10}} \\ & = \frac{{70}}{{30}} \\ & = 7:3 \end{aligned}$$

q: Tanya's grandfather was 8 times older to her 16 years ago. He would be 3 times of her age 8 years from now. 8 years ago, what was the ratio of Tanya's age to that of her grandfather ?
s: 16 years ago, let T = x years and G = 8x years After 8 years from now, T = (x + 16 + 8) years and G = (8x + 16 + 8) years $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore {\text{8x + 24 = 3}}\left( {x + 24} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 8x - 3x = 72 - 24 \\ & \Rightarrow 5x = 48 \\ & 8{\text{years ago,}} \\ & {\text{ }}\frac{{\text{T}}}{{\text{G}}} \\ & = \frac{{x + 8}}{{8x + 8}} \\ & = \frac{{\frac{{48}}{5} + 8}}{{8 \times \frac{{48}}{5} + 8}} \\ & = \frac{{48 + 40}}{{384 + 40}} \\ & = \frac{{88}}{{424}} \\ & = \frac{{11}}{{53}} \end{aligned}$$

q: 6 years ago , the ratio of the ages of Kunal and Sagar was 6 : 5. Four years hence, the ratio of their ages will be 11 : 10. What is Sagar's age at present ?
s: Let the ages of Kunal and Sagar 6 years ago be 6x and 5x years Then, $$\begin{aligned} & \frac{{\left( {6x + 6} \right) + 4}}{{\left( {5x + 6} \right) + 4}} = \frac{{11}}{{10}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{6x + 10}}{{5x + 10}} = \frac{{11}}{{10}} \\ & \Rightarrow 10\left( {6x + 10} \right) = 11\left( {5x + 10} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 60x + 100 = 55x + 100 \\ & \Rightarrow 5x = 10 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 2 \end{aligned}$$ Sagar's present age = (5x + 6) years = (5 × 2 + 6) years = 16 years

q: Sneh's age is $$\frac{1}{6}$$ th of her father's age. Sneh's father's age will be twice of Vimal's age after 10 years. If Vimal's 8th birthday was celebrated 2 years ago,then what is Sneh's present age ?

q: The ages of Sulekha and Arunima are in the ratio 9 : 8 respectively. After 5 years, the ratio of their ages will be 10 : 9. What is the difference in their ages ?
s: Let Sulekha age be 9 year, Then Arunima's age = 8x years $$\begin{aligned} & \frac{{9x + 5}}{{8x + 5}} = \frac{{10}}{9} \\ & \Rightarrow 9\left( {9x + 5} \right) = 10\left( {8x + 5} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 81x + 45 = 80x + 50 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 5 \end{aligned}$$ Difference in their ages = (9x - 8x) years = x years = 5 years

q: X's age 3 years ago was three times the present age of Y. At present Z's age is twice the age of Y. Also Z is 12 years younger than X. What is the present age of Z ?
s: Let the present age of Y be a years Three years ago X's age = 3a years Then, present age of X is (3a + 3) Z's present age = 2a According to question Now, (3a + 3) - 2a = 12 a = 9 year ∴ Present age of Z = 2a = 2 × 9 = 18 years

q: Eight year ago, Poorvi's age was equal to the sum of the present ages of her one son and one daughter. Five years hence, the respective ratio between the ages of her daughter and her son that time will be 7 : 6. If Poorvi's husband is 7 years elder to her and his present age is three times the present age of their son, what is the present age of the daughter ? (in year)
s: Let the age of the son and the daughter of Poorvi be 6a years and 7a years respectively. 5 years hence, present age of son = 6a - 5 and present age of daughter = 7a - 5 According to the question, Eight years ago, the age of Poorvi = 6a - 5 + 7a - 5 = 13a - 10 So, present age of Poorvi = 13a - 10 + 8 = 13a - 2 Since, present age of Poorvi husband = 3 (6a - 5) The difference of present age of Poorvi husband and Poorvi = 7 (Given) $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{3}}\left( {6a - 5} \right) - \left( {13a - 2} \right) = 7 \\ & \Rightarrow 18a - 15 - 13a + 2 = 7 \\ & \Rightarrow 5a = 20 \\ & \Rightarrow a = 4 \end{aligned}$$ The present age of daughter = (7a - 5) = 7 × 4 - 5 = 23 years

q: The sum of present ages of a father and his son is 8 years more than the present age of the mother. The mother is 22 years older than the son. What will be the age of the father after 4 years?
s: Let present age of father , mother and son be x, y and z respectively Sum of present ages of father and son = (Mother's present age + 8 years) x + z = y + 8 years.................(i) Mother's present age = Son's present age + 22 years) ⇒ y = z + 22 years..............(ii) Put the value of y in equation (i) we get x + z = z + 22 + 8 x + z = z + 30 x = 30 years ∴ Father's present age = 30 years Age of father after four years = 30 + 4 = 34 years ∴ Required age of father = 34 years

q: Rahul is as much younger than Sagar as he is older than Purav. If the sum of the ages of Purav and Sagar is 66 years, and Sagar's age is 48 years, then what is the difference between Rahul and Purav's age ? ( in years)
s: Let the age of Rahul, Sagar and Purav be x, y and z respectively According to the given information Age of Sagar - Age of Rahul = Age of Rahul - Age of Purav $$\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow y - x = x - z \\ & \Rightarrow 2x = y + z......(i) \end{aligned}$$ Also y + z = 66 years From (i) x = 33 years Also as per equation (i) we have Purav's age + Sagar age = 66 years by going through option (A) given Purav = 18, and Rahul = 33 years, Sagar = 48 years Difference between Rahul's and Purav's age = 33 - 18 = 15 years

q: Ten years hence, the respective ratio between Simmi's age ans Niti's age will be 7 : 9. Two years ago, the respective ratio between Simmi's and Niti's age was 1 : 3. If Abhay is 4 years older then Niti, what is Abhay's present age ? (in years)
s: Let present ages of Simmi and Niti be a and b years respectively. Ten years hence, the ratio between Simmi's age and Niti's age = 7 : 9 According to question $$\frac{{a + 10}}{{b + 10}} = \frac{7}{9}$$ By cross multiplying we get $$\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow 9a + 90 = 7b + 70 \\ & \Rightarrow 7b - 9a = 20......(i) \\ & {\text{Also}},\frac{{a - 2}}{{b - 2}} = \frac{1}{3} \end{aligned}$$ By cross multiplying we get $$\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow 3a - 6 = b - 2 \\ & \Rightarrow 3a - b = 4.....(ii) \end{aligned}$$ Multiplying equation (ii) by 3 $$9a - 3b = 12.....(iii)$$ Adding equation (ii) and (iii) we get $$\begin{aligned} & - 9a + 7b = 20 \\ & 4b = 32 \\ & b = 8{\text{ year}} \end{aligned}$$ From equation (ii) we get $$\begin{aligned} & a = \frac{{4 + b}}{3} \\ & \,\,\,\,\, = \frac{{4 + 8}}{3} \\ & \,\,\,\,\,\, = \frac{{12}}{3} \\ & \,\,\,\,\,\, = 4\,{\text{year}} \end{aligned}$$ Since, Abhay is 4 years older to Niti So, Abhay's present age = 8 + 4 = 12 years

q: Eight years ago, the ratio of ages of A and B was 5 : 4. The ratio of their present ages is 6 : 5. What will be the sum (in years) of the ages of A and B after 7 years from now?
s: Let the income of A and B be 8 years ago = 5x, 4x $$\begin{aligned} & \frac{{\text{A}}}{{\text{B}}} = \frac{{5x + 8}}{{4x + 8}} = \frac{6}{5} \\ & 25x + 40 = 24x + 48 \\ & x = 8 \\ & \frac{{\text{A}}}{{\text{B}}} = \frac{{5x + 8 + 7}}{{4x + 8 + 7}} \\ & = \frac{{5 \times 8 + 15}}{{4 \times 8 + 15}} \\ & = \frac{{55}}{{47}} \end{aligned}$$ Sum of ages of A and B = A + B = 55 + 47 = 102
